subject.title: [Analysis] Identify performance bottlenecks in native OpenClaw setup on constrained VPS

question: Should this issue be scoped as a public docs/runbook investigation, folded into the broader Gateway event-loop performance tracker, or closed as support-only?
rationale: The request spans docs, runtime instrumentation, configuration guidance, and real host measurement, so automation cannot choose the acceptance criteria or measurement environment safely.

options.title: Scope a VPS runbook
options.body: Keep this open and define a bounded native-Linux measurement plan plus docs deliverable before any optimization PRs.

options.title: Fold into Gateway pressure tracking
options.body: Move only the event-loop and prep-stage portions to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78861 and leave this issue for operator-facing guidance if needed.

options.title: Close as support-only
options.body: Close if maintainers decide OpenClaw core should not own environment-specific performance analysis without a reproducible trace.

recommendation.title: Scope a VPS runbook
recommendation.body: Keep this open and define a bounded native-Linux measurement plan plus docs deliverable before any optimization PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history points to Vincent Koc across the relevant docs and runtime surfaces, and the decision is mostly scoping and performance-infrastructure direction.
